meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: 网页与数字界面设计师在构建Web页面或应用组件时，若受够了千篇一律的AI味设计，请用此技能。一键生成极具视觉冲击力、排版独特、动效惊艳的生产级前端代码，告别平庸，打造令人难忘的高品质数字界面。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成排版独特、动效惊艳的生产级前端代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果受够了千篇一律的AI味网页设计
copy.tagline_en: Generate production-grade frontend code with unique typography and stunning motion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are tired of generic AI-look web designs

howto.what: Claude 会先定下一个明确的美学方向（如极简、杂志感、工业风），再写出可直接运行的前端代码（HTML/CSS/JS、React、Vue 等），并主动避开 Arial、Inter 等常见字体和紫色渐变一类套路。
howto.when: 当你构建网页、页面或应用组件，且不想要常见的 AI 风格设计时，它会接管；原文要求先弄清用途、受众和技术限制，再动手写代码。

say.text: 做一个作品集首页，走杂志编辑风，字体要有辨识度
say.note: 它会先定美学方向，再产出可运行代码

say.text: 把这个 React 组件重做成粗野主义风格，加交错入场动效
say.note: 会换成大胆排版和滚动、悬停效果

say.text: 用克制极简的方式改这个落地页，注意留白和字体细节
say.note: 极简方向会少用动效，强调间距与排版

howto.what_en: Claude first commits to a clear aesthetic direction (minimal, editorial, industrial, etc.), then writes working frontend code — HTML/CSS/JS, React, Vue — while avoiding cliches like Arial, Inter, and purple gradients.
howto.when_en: Use it when building a web page or app component and you don't want generic AI-style design; it asks about purpose and audience before coding.

say_en.text: Build a portfolio homepage in an editorial magazine style, with distinctive fonts
say_en.note: It picks an aesthetic direction, then writes working code

say_en.text: Rework this React component in a brutalist style with staggered load animations
say_en.note: Swaps in bold type plus scroll and hover effects

say_en.text: Rework this landing page with restrained minimalism — focus on whitespace and type
say_en.note: Minimalist direction means less motion, tighter spacing
